section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes an analysis that examined the magnitude of the correlation between body appreciation and body image flexibility and whether BMI moderated associations with body dissatisfaction in a pre-college sample of Black older-adolescent females. The section situates the findings within cognitive-behavioral affect regulation frameworks and calls for further multicultural-inclusive research on positive body image.
